title: Output of AI Brand Visibility Tracker
description: One row per check (prompt x sample) in the default dataset; the share-of-voice summary in the OUTPUT record. Skipped or capped checks are explained in a free status row.

checks.title: Checks (one row per prompt x sample)
checks.description: Example: {"prompt":"Best wiki tool for a startup?","sample":1,"brandMentioned":true,"brandRank":2,"brandCited":false,"brandSentiment":"positive","competitorsMentioned":["Coda","Confluence"],"citedDomains":["zapier.com"],"status":"ok"}. Status row: {"status":"stopped","error":"Stopped: Reached your maximum cost per run…"}.

summary.title: Share-of-voice summary
summary.description: JSON: brandMentionRate, leaderboard (mentions, citations, sentiment per brand), checksRequested, checksRun, charged, truncated, freePlanLimited, notice and stoppedReason.
